title: Token overrides definition
description: Shared token-override map used by anatomy parts, variant values, and states. Keys name the visual attribute; values reference the token used. Token references MUST name a documented token, never a raw value.

tokenOverrides.description: Token overrides for one part, variant value, or state. Keys name the visual attribute (ex: 'background', 'text-color', 'border-radius'); values are a token `identifier` (ex: 'color-action-primary', 'radius-md'). Every value here is a token reference, so it's written as a plain identifier — no braces. (This differs from a design-specifications value, which can be a token or a raw value and so wraps token references in braces.) When the system documents a token layer, each value MUST resolve to a documented token. Raw values (ex: '#ffffff', '4px') are not allowed here — token-less systems put those in design-specifications.
